marca-800.note: 11,66:1 on white. Brand navy, taken from the logo pixels. Figures and dark fills.

marca-600.note: 7,78:1 on white. Every interactive navy: button fill, link hover, outline stroke.

acento-500.note: Brand green. 2,43:1 on white — fill and graphic only, never text on a light surface.

acento-700.note: 4,73:1 on white. The only green permitted to set text on white.

realce-400.note: Brand amber. 1,86:1 on white — fill and graphic only.

realce-700.note: 5,21:1 on white. The only amber permitted to set text on white.

neutral-900.note: Tailwind gray-900, deliberately NOT aliased to the brand ramps. Headings, and the dark hero/footer fill. The dark-fill use is recorded drift, not a rule.

neutral-600.note: All running prose. The system does not set body copy in black.

neutral-200.note: The 1px card and divider border. The primary depth device in this system.

neutral-300.note: Input borders, tertiary outline buttons, and footer body text on dark (6,8:1).

neutral-0.note: Every card, panel, input and content surface.

danger-700.note: Form error panels only. Red exists in this system exclusively as a semantic error state; the retired isotipo red must not return as a brand color.

narrative.overview:
This is the visual language of a technical report handed across a desk in Yopal: navy ink on white paper, real figures set in tabular numerals, no ornament competing with the data. The buyer arrives with a compliance obligation and minutes to spend, so every surface is built to be scanned — bordered white cards on a near-white field, one navy accent doing all the work of emphasis, and a type ramp that only has as many steps as the content needs. The system's confidence comes from the specificity of what it shows (1.174 servicios, 315 empresas, 41 ciudades), not from styling applied on top.

The palette is unusually disciplined for a marketing site because it has to be: green and amber are the brand's own colors but fail contrast as text on white (2,43:1 and 1,86:1), so they are restricted to fill and graphic roles. That single constraint produced the house look — a monochrome navy system with two colors held in reserve. Depth is carried almost entirely by hairline borders and a barely-there shadow; the site reads flat and printed rather than layered and glassy.

The system is mid-refactor. Its quality bar lives in /cobertura, /cobertura/[region] and /trabaja-con-nosotros: restrained navy-on-white, real data, no decoration. The home page and /servicios/[slug] still carry an earlier, heavier vocabulary (gradient-filled cards, blurred color orbs, glassmorphic panels, hover-scale on everything). Where this document names a standard, it names the interior-page treatment; the home page's variants are recorded as what shipped, not as what to copy.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-on-white monochrome; green and amber are fill-only, never body text on light surfaces
Hairline 1px neutral borders instead of shadow as the primary separator
Fully-round pill buttons on content pages, 12px radius on forms
Figures in tabular numerals with tight tracking; the number is the biggest thing on the page
Lucide line icons at a single stroke weight, aria-hidden unless labelled — no emoji anywhere in src/

rules.name: The Aliased Palette Rule
rules.body: Never read a color off the markup. blue-600 in a template is navy #35547a. New templates must use marca-*, acento-* and realce-* directly; the legacy names are a migration shim, not a palette.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Rule
rules.body: Brand green and brand amber never set text on a white surface. If green or amber must carry a word, it is acento-700 or realce-700 — no exceptions, including on hover.

rules.name: The One Navy Rule
rules.body: A screen gets one accent hue. Navy is it. Green and amber appear as at most one graphic element per section, and never two accents in the same component.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Any number presented as evidence is set in tabular-nums with tracking-tight, in marca-800, and marked up as the <dd> of a <dl> whose <dt> names it. Numbers are data, not decoration.

rules.name: The Bare Lockup Rule
rules.body: A heading stands alone. No eyebrow or kicker line above it, no two-tone split across an h1, no decorative rule beneath it. The heading and its supporting paragraph are the entire lockup.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Variable sets everything. There is no display/body pairing to honor and no second family to introduce; hierarchy comes from size and weight alone.

rules.name: The Header Clearance Rule
rules.body: The header is fixed. Any page whose first band is light must open with pt-28; a page whose first band is a dark full-bleed hero uses pt-20 on main and lets the hero absorb the offset.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose is capped at max-w-3xl. A paragraph that runs the full 72rem container is a bug.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated from its background by a 1px neutral-200 border first. Shadow is additive and never stronger than shadow-sm at rest.

rules.name: The Motion-On-Response Rule
rules.body: Nothing animates at rest. Elevation and translation are responses to hover or focus, they run at duration-300 with the default ease, and they move at most 4px.

rules.name: The Pill-or-Twelve Rule
rules.body: Navigational and CTA buttons are fully round (rounded-full); form submit buttons and inputs are rounded-xl (12px) so they align with the fields above them. A button never takes a card's rounded-2xl.

rules.name: The Band Gradient Rule
rules.body: A gradient may fill a full-width section band. It may not fill a card, a button, an icon tile or a chip.

dos: Do write new templates against marca-*, acento-* and realce-*. The blue-*/green-*/orange-* aliases exist to keep legacy markup on-brand, not to be extended.
Do use marca-600 for anything interactive and marca-800 for figures and dark fills.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px neutral-200 hairline before reaching for a shadow.
Do set every evidence number in tabular-nums + tracking-tight inside a <dl>/<dt>/<dd>.
Do cap prose at max-w-3xl and set body copy in neutral-600 at 14–16px with leading-relaxed.
Do open light interior pages with pt-28 to clear the fixed header.
Do route every icon through Icono.svelte with a concept key, and give it an etiqueta only when no adjacent text already names it.
Do render <PageHeader /> and <PageFooter /> on every route. They are the shell; the shared footer also carries the internal link graph the site depends on.
Do keep the h1 ramp at text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl.
donts: Don't set body or label text in acento-500 or realce-400 on a white surface. They fail AA (2,43:1 and 1,86:1). Use acento-700 / realce-700 when the word must be colored.
Don't introduce red outside the error state. The old isotipo red is retired.
Don't put a gradient inside a card, button, chip or icon tile. Gradients fill full-width bands.
Don't stack shadow-xl/shadow-2xl on a resting surface, and don't add blurred color orbs (blur-3xl circles) or backdrop-blur glass panels to new work.
Don't animate anything at rest — no animate-pulse on a CTA, no hover:scale on a button.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, two-tone <span> or decorative rule in a heading lockup.
Don't type a literal →, · or any pictographic character where the icon system should draw it.
Don't add a second typeface or a weight outside 400 / 500 / 600 / 700.
Don't hand-roll a page-level <footer>; import PageFooter.
Don't invent testimonials, review stars, price tables or trust badges — there is no evidence behind them and the system has no component for them.
notCanonized: The /cobertura h1 still splits into a two-tone <span class="text-blue-600">, which the Bare Lockup Rule forbids.
Literal → and · glyphs are typed into link and list text on /cobertura and /cobertura/[region] where Icono.svelte exists to draw them.
The home page's animate-pulse CTA and blur-3xl decorative orbs are resting animation and pure ornament.
The dark heroes' neutral gray-900 fill is recorded as drift rather than promoted to a dark-surface token, because legitimizing it would write a near-black into a navy brand system.
/servicios/[slug], /validar-certificado, /politicas-de-privacidad and /ingreso ship without the PageHeader/PageFooter shell.
